thread:
sre-bot: [ALERT] Autoscaler: nodepool 'gpu-prod-eu' failed to scale: reached max nodes (50). queue_growth=4200, qps_surge=+180%, 429_rate=7.3% — immediate action recommended

jamie (oncall): saw the pager. checking pods and pending pods now. tagging infra.

priya (platform): looks like HPA couldn't provision due to nodepool maxNodes. also seeing ImagePullBackOff on a few infra init containers caused by backoff loops. link to queue dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/queue-growth?orgId=1

ethan (infra): I'm here. can we confirm current maxNodes? I'll pull cloud console and quota.

jamie (oncall): quick debug output: kubectl get pods -n inference | egrep 'Pending|ContainerCreating' ->
`````
NAME                                        READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-worker-5k8z7                      0/1     Pending   0          12m
inference-worker-5k8z8                      0/1     Pending   0          11m
inference-worker-5k9a1                      0/1     Pending   0          9m
`````

jamie (oncall): kubectl describe nodepool gpu-prod-eu shows autoscaler at maxNodes=50 and current nodes=50 — pods stuck Pending due to no schedulable nodes with GPUs.

ethan (infra): confirmed in cloud console: node pool gpu-prod-eu maxSize: 50, current: 50. no available GPUs in region. I can request a temporary bump to 70, but need emergency approval channel. tagging @michael and @priya for fast-track.

michael (prod-eng): we got 500s and streaming timeouts noticed starting ~11:03Z. two paying customers reported degraded responses. we should bump now. :grimacing:

hana (support): tickets inbound. letting affected customers know we're triaging; will provide ETA once mitigation starts.

priya (platform): couple of risk notes: bumping maxNodes may hit account GPU quota. if quota insufficient, cloud request could take longer. we should also temporarily relax pod anti-affinity and affinity rules so pending pods can pack onto mixed instances.

ethan (infra): filing emergency request in cloud workflow with justification (production degradation). starting approval flow now — might be ~5–8 mins for permission. PD incident #INC12345 attached.

sre-bot: PagerDuty incident #INC12345 assigned to jamie (oncall).

ethan (infra): manual steps queued. If approved I'll run:
`````
gcloud container node-pools update gpu-prod-eu --cluster=redwood-prod --max-nodes=70 --region=eu-west1
`````

jamie (oncall): meanwhile I muted non-essential alerts and increased worker queue consumers to shed backlog where possible. added temporary routing rule to move low-priority requests to fallback model variant.

ethan (infra): cloud approval granted. executing nodepool update now. ETA for new nodes ~4–6 mins for GPU provisioning.

ethan (infra): command complete, autoscaler sees new headroom. watching scheduling.

jamie (oncall): pods are transitioning to Running. pending count dropped from ~1200 to ~240 in 3 minutes. scheduler logs show "Successfully assigned" for multiple inference-worker pods.

priya (platform): applied temporary scheduler tuning: reduced pod CPU request floor and enabled burst scheduling window. also disabled strict PodDisruptionBudget for non-critical jobs to free up packing.

michael (prod-eng): rolling additional replicas to help consume backlog. watching p95/p99 latency; streaming LAT spikes coming down.

hana (support): updated customers A and B with mitigation progress and expected recovery timeline. they acknowledged.

ethan (infra): setting maxNodes=70 as temporary for 4 hours. opening follow-up ticket to evaluate long-term pool sizing, quota requests, and autoscaler policy to avoid manual intervention next time. ticket: INFRA-6789.

jamie (oncall): handing off to priya for daytime follow-up and postmortem. oncall clear at 06:22Z.

priya (platform): taking postmortem ownership. immediate action items: (1) extend autoscaler soft limit with burst delta, (2) add a Grafana alert when nodepool utilization > 85% for 5m, (3) document manual bump runbook and emergency cloud workflow. creating Confluence page now: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/INC12345

sre-bot: Incident mitigated — queue draining, 429s reduced from 7.3% -> 0.9% within 14m of node bump. Monitoring period: 1h.

hana (support): closing interim customer notifications; will reopen if regressions.

michael (prod-eng): please include action item to evaluate multi-region spillover and scale policies for bursty token-heavy workloads.

priya (platform): ack. will schedule a cross-team review. postmortem skeleton created and assigned.
